page.notes: Printed page number "435" is hard to read; the last digit may be a 5 or a long s, so it is marked [?]. The drop capital C of "Conveniunt" is a large letter; the first word is read as Conveniunt. The gathering signature "Ec ÿ" is partly worn; the final character is doubtful. The two marginal notes Ioan.14.3. and Ioan.16.7. stand in the right margin beside the lines with "du-" and "Spi-". Printed spacing and punctuation such as "Ob..Ante" and "Diabolo.Nisi" are reproduced as far as the scan shows.
